title: ChirpCaster
tagline: Chirpcaster is an innovative push-to-talk decentralized application (dApp) designed to facilitate real-time voice communication over blockchain networks.
description:
Chirp Caster is an innovative push-to-talk decentralized application (dApp) designed to facilitate real-time voice communication over blockchain networks
. 
Powered by Huddle01, Chirp Caster enables seamless, secure, and efficient voice interactions. It uses the Filecoin EVM to manage user profiles and voice channels, ensuring reliable and decentralized management of user data. 

With end-to-end encryption provided by Lit Protocol and image storage on IPFS, users can communicate confidently, knowing their data is protected and resilient. Ideal for both personal and professional use, Chirp Caster combines the convenience of instant voice messaging with the robust security and transparency of blockchain technology, revolutionizing the way we connect and collaborate in the digital age.
how_its_made:
Chirp Caster is an innovative push-to-talk decentralized application (dApp) designed to facilitate real-time voice communication over blockchain networks. Built on Next.js, Chirp Caster uses the Filecoin EVM to manage user profiles and voice channels, ensuring reliable and decentralized data management. 

It utilizes the Huddle01 SDK for seamless and efficient voice communications. For security, Chirp Caster employs Lit Protocol for end-to-end encryption of messages, allowing users to communicate with confidence, knowing their data is protected and resilient. 

Additionally, Chirp Caster utilizes RainbowKit and WAGI for enhanced user experience and Ethers.js for blockchain interactions. Ideal for both personal and professional use, Chirp Caster revolutionizes the way we connect and collaborate in the digital age with its robust security and advanced technology.
